items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is in range, every volume (40/45/50/90/200 µL) is handled by the p300, and the wells are never overfilled (checks pass).
Every transfer uses new_tip='always', so each sample well gets its own tip. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.

All 13 steps are present in order with the right volumes, mix_after=(10, 40) is used for beads and water, and the manual steps are recorded with protocol.comment. The only variation is the 40 µL elution mix volume, which the task leaves open.
p300.transfer(40, beads, samples, mix_after=(10,40), new_tip='always') is followed by the comment 'Incubate sample_plate 5 min' before the magnet comment.
The magnet-engage comment comes first. Then 90 µL is removed per well to waste, followed by two 200 µL ethanol add and remove-to-waste cycles.
Comments record the 5 min dry and the magnet disengage. Then 50 µL water is added with mix_after 10, followed by the 2 min incubate and magnet re-engage comment.
p300.transfer(45, samples, eluates, new_tip='always') pairs the wells in order, and the end_state:elution_plate check passes.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and every measured check passes. It follows all 13 steps in order, with one fresh tip per well and the manual steps recorded as comments.
